  - Both have a dark and introspective tone exploring themes of mortality and trauma.
  - Both feature strong, complex female protagonists.
  - "The Silent Companions" is more horror-focused and slower-burning, while "The Stranger Diaries" is more traditional mystery and faster-paced.
